A weekly record of my progress through the course. Each entry starts with the session or topic covered, then goes through what I worked on, the ideas I struggled with, how I worked through them, and what I understood by the end of the week. Each one ends with links to the related tutorials and projects. My use of AI tools is recorded separately in the [AI use log](../ai-use-log.qmd).
